_handoff.scope: Unauthenticated public-workflow pass for the default Bengaluru scenario: an already registered death and certificate copy.
_handoff.observationNote: Read-only observation of the public SmartNet Birth & Death Certificate Details page with Death Certificate selected. Registration Number, Temporary Registration No., and Using DOD controls were inspected without entering any identifier, date, or name. No login, OTP, CAPTCHA, lookup, payment, upload, download, or submission was attempted. Direct navigation to the legacy BBMP citizen-services URL failed with the browser-reported text `net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED`; this pass stops at the identifier/name/date boundary.

sources.title: Birth & Death Certificate Details — public lookup
sources.notes: Direct unauthenticated page observation. The page footer identifies Bengaluru Smart City Limited/BenSCL and Version 1.3. Death Certificate was selected, then each public search-mode control was inspected without entering values.

sources.title: Contact Us — Bengaluru Smart City Limited
sources.notes: Public contact page publishes phone `080-22200080` and email `bsclnodal@gmail.com`. This is a published support lead, not a promise of record resolution.

sources.title: FAQ'S — One City One Portal
sources.notes: Public FAQ says citizens use the relevant service interface/widget and answers that One City One Portal is free. It contains no death-specific no-record or lookup-error remedy.

sources.title: BBMP Citizen Services — Birth & Death Certificate directory
sources.notes: Direct navigation was attempted without entering data. The browser reported the exact network failure text `net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED`; no page body or service form loaded. This is an endpoint/infrastructure failure, not a death-record no-match result.

claims.text: The public SmartNet Birth & Death Certificate Details page exposes a certificate-type selector with `--Select--`, `Birth Certificate`, and `Death Certificate`; Death Certificate can be selected without entering case data.
claims.notes: Observed unauthenticated on 2026-08-30; selecting the certificate type transmitted no personal data.

claims.text: After Death Certificate is selected, the public `Search by` selector exposes `Registration Number`, `Temporary Registration No.`, and `Using DOD`.
claims.notes: Each option was viewed; no mode was submitted.

claims.text: The public `Registration Number` mode renders a `Registration Number` textbox and a `Date Of Death` textbox with placeholder `Ex:15-01-22`; no values were entered.
claims.notes: The registration identifier/date boundary was observed and is the stop point for this pass.

claims.text: The public `Temporary Registration No.` mode renders a `Temporary Registration No.` textbox; no temporary registration number was entered.
claims.notes: The field label was inspected without typing or submitting.

claims.text: The public `Using DOD` mode renders `Date Of Death` with placeholder `Ex:2022-01-15`, plus `Name`, `Father Name`, and `Mother Name` textboxes; no date or names were entered.
claims.notes: Names and date of death are case-specific data; this pass stopped before the fields were populated.

claims.text: The public lookup page shows `Back` and `Submit` controls after a death search mode is selected; neither control was used to submit a lookup in this pass.
claims.notes: Visible controls were recorded; validation, no-record text, and output remain unobserved because activation would cross the submission boundary.

claims.text: On 2026-08-30, direct navigation to the specific BBMP Citizen Services directory URL failed before page load with the browser-reported text `net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED`.
claims.notes: This is a connection failure of the legacy directory URL, not evidence that a death record is absent.

claims.text: The BenSCL Contact Us page publishes phone `080-22200080` and email `bsclnodal@gmail.com`; the SmartNet death lookup page also exposes a `ContactUs` link and a `Back` control.
claims.notes: Published navigation/support only; neither page promises a death-record no-match remedy, status result, fee reversal, or certificate issuance.

claims.text: This public-only pass does not establish post-identifier validation, no-record messaging, login/OTP requirements, certificate download, acknowledgement, fee, status tracking, or recovery after a failed death-record lookup.
claims.notes: The pass stopped before identifier/name/date entry and before Submit. This is a research boundary, not evidence that the service lacks these behaviors.
